ideas.title: Investigating the Trump Administration's Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Trump administration's child care funding freeze, including the impact on child care providers and families.
questions: What were the motivations behind the funding freeze?
How have child care providers and families been affected?
searches: Trump administration child care funding freeze
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for transparency in government funding decisions.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the 'fraud tourists' scheme.
questions: What are the common characteristics of Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota?
How can these schemes be prevented in the future?
ideas.insight: I suspect that this story may reveal a larger pattern of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and that data analysis can help identify potential vulnerabilities in the system.
